title: Get Started with AI agents in Unreal Engine 5
author: gislikonradsson
selftext:
(I also wrote a book about it if you are interested - [Link to my book!](https://shop.oroi.is/products/pre-order-getting-started-with-agentic-development-in-unreal-engine) )

I've been an Unreal Engine game developer for around 15 years.  I recently joined a company to take over an Unreal Project thats been in development for a few years and has gone through multiple development teams.  I decided to give AI agents and AI tools a real chance and it made a huge impact for me.

I've not only been able to take much of the old code/content in the project and isolate it so that its  editable by AI (much of the logic was in blueprints before). But I have most of the critical game loops testable through data driven tests.

I´ve had a book in the works about automation and testing in Unreal Engine for a few years and adding the AI agent angle really was the missing piece.

Anyone else doing AI gamedev in Unreal Engine?
